name: Himuro Yui
source:
A young schoolgirl she has a major brother complex. When she witnesses Serina kill a demon she's given the choice to become a magical girl or die. Extremely friendly and kind she sets out to befriend the cold hearted Serina while protecting those she loves from demons.

Her magical power is AA Rank.
